market.title: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez — 2028 U.S. Presidential Election Winner
resolutionNote: Resolves to whoever is inaugurated President in January 2029, based on AP/Fox/NBC race calls.

text: AOC has earned her place as a genuine contender for the 2028 presidential election, even though she hasn't yet publicly announced her intention to run.
She has admitted that she is still undecided as to whether to run for the presidency, the Senate, or neither, and has not taken any steps towards a campaign.
Regardless, AOC is polling well, regularly near or ahead of established names such as Pete Buttigieg and Kamala Harris in Democratic surveys.
In the odds for the Democratic nomination, she recently shot above her closest rival Gavin Newsom, who has seen a steady decline as fresh details of an affair with a former aide surfaced.
Some Republican commentators have claimed AOC is softening on her "woke" tone and becoming more centrist to secure a larger support base.
marketBrief.author: Owain Flanders
